question: The curved surface area and circumference of the base of a solid right circular cylinder are 2200 cm² and 110 cm, respectively. Find the height of the cylinder.
solution:
**Given:**

CSA = 2200 cm²

C = 110 cm

**Formula used:**

CSA(Cylinder) = 2 x 22/7 x r x h

Circumference of circle = 2 x 22/7 x r

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/405bb618f15ddc5119d7b4574912d04e2f9826a85d8858c91ffa3c203232a99c.png] 

2 x 22/7 x r = 110

r = 70/4 = 35/2 cm

2 x 22/7 x 35/2 x h = 2200

h = 2200/110 = 20 cm

Height = 20 cm

**Hence, the correct option is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Base of a solid cylinder = 2πr = 110cm

The curved surface area of cylinder = 2200cm2 

⇒ 2πrh = 2200

⇒ 110 × h = 2200

⇒ h = 2200/110 = 20cm
